## What's your idea?

Describe what you'd like Neuro Granny to do.

## What problem would it solve?

Is something missing, inconvenient, or harder than it needs to be? Tell us a little about it.

## How would you like it to work?

Describe your ideal solution. A simple example is perfectly fine.

## Anything else?

Alternative ideas, screenshots, sketches, or additional context are welcome.

---

Thanks for sharing your idea! Neuro Granny aims to stay simple, offline, and focused on remembering things. Not every suggestion will make it into the app, but all ideas are welcome.
